jtbd.jtbd_title: PSAT score x‑ray; intensify targeted SAT Math drills
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Translate PSAT subscores into drill queues, schedule retest window, and measure with mistake‑log deltas.

interactions.user_ask: How do I convert these subscores into a plan?
interactions.jenny_reply: Each subscore creates a drill queue. Start with 10 reps/topic for 3 days, track deltas in your mistake log.
Mini‑tests every 10 days; full test every 3 weeks. Always do a 30‑minute post‑mortem.

outcomes.details: Subscores → drill queues mapping; delta fields added
